pages.text: When you die, your $(l)armour, offhand, hotbar and accessories$() come back with you.$(br2)Your $(l)pack$() (the rest of your inventory) and your experience stay on your $(l)corpse$() where you fell. It never rots away. Go back for it. Friends can open it too, so be nice.
Every death is counted on the player list ($(l)Tab$()). Every tenth is announced. $(o)YOU DIED$() is not a suggestion.
